lessons.title: Record money coming in
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
A budget starts with knowing what money is available and when it arrives. Write down income you actually receive, and label uncertain income separately. Use a period that matches how you manage your expenses.

lessons.title: Plan bills and essentials
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
List upcoming bills with their due dates. Consider necessary expenses and flexible purchases, remembering that needs depend on your situation. If a plan does not cover essential bills, identify the gap early and seek suitable local guidance.
